fields.prompt_precision: The three noise doses as percentages, the two sound levels in dBA and the last value in minutes, all to six decimals.
fields.evidence: Sum of C/T with T = 8/2^((L-90)/5), periods under 90 dropped; formula stated in the prompt. Panels (NoiseDosimeterExplorer, ProtectionChemicalsExplorer, HeatStressExplorer) show fixed teaching records only (select-only, no record inputs), so they cannot be set to the capstone case. Recomputed from the prompt's own formulas at full precision: equal to expected (difference below 1e-13). tol 5e-7 is half a unit of the six decimals the prompt asks for.
